coverLetter: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Laravel/Vue.js Developer position at PositiveLinks. As a Full Stack Engineer with 7+ years of experience building scalable applications using Laravel and Vue.js, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your high-performance team and help drive your 10X growth mission.

My background aligns perfectly with your requirements. At BSE America, I architected and developed a comprehensive CRM system using Laravel 10+ with RESTful APIs, implementing SOLID principles and scalable architecture for WooCommerce integration and electronic billing. I optimized MySQL queries and database schemas for high-volume transactions, achieving 99%+ API reliability. Additionally, I implemented CI/CD pipelines with AWS S3 deployments, reducing deployment time by 80% while mentoring team members on Laravel and Vue best practices.

Currently at Delfín Motor Labs, I am developing high-performance Vue.js/Nuxt.js applications with TypeScript, focusing on reusable composables, state management with Pinia, and pixel-perfect UI components using HTML5, CSS3, Sass, and Tailwind. I thrive in fast-moving environments and have consistently delivered results that drive business impact—such as improving Core Web Vitals and reducing response times by 52% through strategic caching implementations.

I am particularly drawn to PositiveLinks' commitment to excellence, fully flexible remote work culture, and fast career growth opportunities. I am eager to bring my expertise in Laravel, Vue.js, RESTful API development, and Agile methodologies to your team, and I look forward to contributing to the global products you're building.
Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills and experience can help PositiveLinks achieve its ambitious goals.
